|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is the current text. The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V1-D-stalker.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V1-D-stalker-2022-10-03-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V1-D-stalker-2022-07-05.png]], 5 July 2022) → [[File:V1-D-stalker-2022-10-03-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V1-D-stalker.gif]], 3 October 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints “E1”, but this is errata 2 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Stalker (V)]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-stalker022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/stalker.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Dark/large/stalker.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261113121305/https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 Internet Archive primary-source copy]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114035433/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections381-batch7-primary-sources.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). If opponent's starship just moved from here, Stalker may follow it as a regular move (if within range).”

'''What changed:''' “passengers, 2 vehicles and 4” → “passengers, 2 vehicles, and 4”; “of 1. If opponent's starship” → “of 1. Once per game, may follow an opponent's starship”; “opponent's starship just moved” → “opponent's starship that just moved”; “moved from here, Stalker may follow it as a regular move (if within” → “moved from here (if within”; the errata mark “E” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); the bottom margin “•''Stalker''” → “''Stalker''” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (348×488 → 745×1039 pixels). Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Once per game, may follow an opponent's starship that just moved from here (if within range).” This image was first published on 18 March 2021 as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/hires/stalker.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2f0f28b5b6fa47e28f68524abf93bcb326a93280 commit 2f0f28b]); the card-size GIF uploaded 5 July 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a41bae9a74e1300c2325f6f584bab72b56ff28fe commit a41bae9], earlier listed as its own version, PC-E2) is a later copy of the same image in another format, so it is not a new version (a version is one distinct image, dated when it was first published in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
